resources.string: Keeps ordinary Chinese letter taps in touch-down order when fingers overlap. Slide and long-press actions keep their own handling.
Keeps the original pinyin and offers a word candidate from one touch-based alternative. Tap the candidate marked * to use it. Overrides inline touch correction while enabled.
Correction candidate %1$s; original pinyin is preserved
Uses touch position and pinyin probabilities only near key boundaries. Clear center taps keep their original key. Your input is not uploaded.
Learns touch offsets locally only from keys you explicitly confirm or restore. Password fields are excluded.
